perks.name: Proximity Power
perks.description: When targets are nearby, final blows grant bonus Melee stat.

enhanced.name: Proximity Power
enhanced.description: When targets are nearby, final blows grant an improved amount of bonus Melee stat.

perks.name: Replenishing Aegis
perks.description: Blocking damage partially reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Replenishing Aegis
enhanced.description: Blocking damage partially reloads this weapon from reserves. Shortens delay between activations.

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.description: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.

enhanced.name: Disruption Break
enhanced.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

enhanced.name: Repulsor Brace
enhanced.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield that lasts for an improved duration.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.description: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

enhanced.name: Lead from Gold
enhanced.description: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants increased ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Overflow
perks.description: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo automatically loads this weapon beyond normal capacity.

enhanced.name: Overflow
enhanced.description: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo loads this weapon even further beyond normal capacity.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

enhanced.name: Envious Assassin
enhanced.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers additional ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Destabilizing Rounds
enhanced.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for an improved duration.

perks.name: Redirection
perks.description: Damaging rank-and-file combatants increases damage against more powerful ones.

enhanced.name: Redirection
enhanced.description: Damaging rank-and-file combatants increases damage against more powerful ones. Powerful shots consume fewer stacks.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

enhanced.name: Unrelenting
enhanced.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers improved health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one target.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Binary Orbit
enhanced.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for an improved duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Unstoppable Force
perks.description: Blocking damage with your shield increases projectile damage for a short time.

enhanced.name: Unstoppable Force
enhanced.description: Blocking damage with your shield increases projectile damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Close to Melee
perks.description: Glaive projectile final blows improve Glaive melee damage. Glaive projectile or melee damage extends the duration.

enhanced.name: Close to Melee
enhanced.description: Glaive projectile final blows improve Glaive melee damage for an improved duration. Glaive projectile or melee damage extends the duration.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

enhanced.name: Sword Logic
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.
